title: draba hispanica subsp. djurdjurae
intro: Draba hispanica subsp. djurdjurae, commonly known as Djurdjura rock cress, is a subspecies of the Draba hispanica species, a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a rare and endemic plant found in Algeria, primarily growing on limestone and granite rocks. The plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Draba hispanica subsp. djurdjurae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-histaminic activities.
